comparison.same_budget_ablation: Compare the sector sleeve against actual QQQ with each candidate's identical aggregate equity/gold budgets, decision dates, funding and costs.

methodology.hypothesis: Information technology and semiconductor equity holdings represent different industrial concentration from Nasdaq-100 growth beta. Test whether their actual fund returns add net value inside the same four-factor/gold architecture, rather than infer alpha from a technology or AI narrative.
methodology.allocation: Keep half of the equity sleeve equally divided across the original four registered factor families. Allocate its other half to the candidate's single actual sector ETF. Reuse the frozen composed_monthly_target helper through an explicit sector-to-growth-column adapter:63-session marginal sleeve volatility,30%-70%equity bounds,monthly decisions and98%target investment. No window,sector-share,threshold or leverage grid.
methodology.risk: Sector and industry concentration can increase common market beta and tail risk. Positive factor weights do not establish independent risk sources. The original strict Sharpe,SPY and15%drawdown goals must all pass in both horizons and base/stress.
methodology.source: Admission requires the actual issuer mandate and fund identity,primary non-multiplied equity-index implementation evidence,complete positive-volume post-inception quotes and explained corporate actions. Preserve every failed request;do not bypass audience,API or access gates. Current fund documents are not a full historical methodology archive.
methodology.execution: Retain freshUSD10,000accounts,2%target cash,USD1per order,5bpnext-openbase and20bpextra-sessionstress. Require the registered funded-accountingv2 and independentbt paths. No leveraged products,shorting or synthetic risk-free carry.
methodology.selection: Exactly two hypotheses after112exposed historical configurations. Register source/code/specifications before outcomes. A historical pass is not independent validation;the frozen22review joint-selection diagnostic excludes these new candidates.
methodology.catalog: Sector satellites are not new economic factor definitions and do not consume or bypass the weekly discovery quota. IJR/PKWdefinitions and six-family candidates remain queued until the real2026-10-17T09:00+08:00cycle.
